summary: VSee Health, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the divestiture of its wholly-owned subsidiary VSee Lab, Inc. to co-CEO and Chairman Milton Chen. On May 31, 2026, Mr. Chen agreed to purchase all equity of VSee Lab in exchange for transferring 2,870,069 shares of VSee Health common stock he owns. The Company retains pre-closing liabilities, while Mr. Chen assumes subsidiary debt/liabilities post-closing. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock exchange with no cash consideration. Watch for related-party transaction scrutiny and any subsequent shareholder litigation.
